name: Main Site Deployable Integration Kit
goal: 把 v24 的主站對接從範例升級成可搬移清單、安裝 manifest、路由對照、環境檢查與回滾方案。
non_goals: 不在後端知識庫生成文章正文
不把卑南文化遺址/Beinan Site 當成卑南族文化來源
不把候選來源自動公開

main_site_routes.purpose: 檢查 KB public + internal HMAC 連線
主站 server-side AI provider adapter；不得在 browser 暴露 AI key
把 AI 草稿送 KB 做引用/去重/禁止關聯/敏感檢查
通過基本檢查後送 KB review queue
主站後台對 KB 審核動作代理

readiness_checks: POST /api/internal/security/v25/verify-hmac returns signature_valid=true from server runtime
POST /api/internal/ai-article/v24/client-draft/validate rejects forbidden Beinan/Peinan archaeology relation
Admin review action endpoint writes audit event
rollback: keep old main-site /api/ai/compose route under /api/ai/compose-legacy for one deploy window
toggle PINUYUMAYAN_HMAC_ENABLED=false only in staging if emergency debugging is needed
do not delete old article drafts; mark superseded_by_v25 in review metadata
